corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez infinitive 'ለተደልዎ' (from ተደለወ, as repeated in line 18); the 1st-order 'ደ' and 6th-order 'ል' were transposed as 'ድላ' in Stage 1.
Ge'ez 3rd-person feminine singular object suffix requires 4th-order 'ኣ' ('ዘይከልኣ', parallel to 'ዘያርኅቃ', 'ዘያኀድጋ'), and the shortened left leg of 'ኣ' is visible in the print.
The printed glyph is 'ፅ' (ፀ-series 6th order with circular head, matching 'ዐመፃ' in line 12), not 'ጽ'.
Canonical Ge'ez of 2 Peter 2:16 'ወከልኦ ለነቢይ እበዲሁ' with 7th-order 'ኦ' (masculine singular pronominal object suffix anticipating 'ለነቢይ'), clearly visible with the upper right loop on 'ኦ'.
The printed glyph has the round head of 'ፁ' ('የማይደነግፁ', matching 'ኢይደነግፁ' in line 27), not 'ጹ'.
